concepts.name: Electric Current
concepts.description: Rate of flow of electric charges through a conductor (I = Q/t).

concepts.name: Potential Difference
concepts.description: Work done to move a unit positive charge between two points in an electric field (V = W/Q).

concepts.name: Resistance
concepts.description: Opposition offered by a substance to the flow of electric current (R = rho * L / A).

concepts.name: Ohm's Law
concepts.description: Direct proportionality of current to potential difference at constant temperature (V = IR).

concepts.name: Series Circuits
concepts.description: Connection of resistors in a single closed loop where current remains identical (Req = sum(Ri)).

concepts.name: Parallel Circuits
concepts.description: Connection of resistors across common points where voltage across branches is identical (1/Req = sum(1/Ri)).

concepts.name: Electrical Power
concepts.description: Rate at which electric energy is dissipated or consumed in an electric circuit (P = VI = I^2*R = V^2/R).
